text:
priya: opened a docs PR, link below. main goals: fix a couple of broken model-source links, clarify model name casing, and update the SDK snippet for the new client. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 :eyes:

mike: saw the CI linkcheck fail. one of the links points at our internal bucket path that changed last week. will drop a redirect but we should fix the doc too.

alex: quick note on casing — the model catalog uses 'ZephyrX-7B' in some cards and 'zephyrx7b' in examples. this confuses the runtime mapping. can we normalize to the Catalog display name and add a small note about API aliasing?

laura: SDK snippet currently shows the old sync client. need to update to the new async client usage. small example suggestion: ```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient()
await client.generate(model="zephyrx-7b", prompt="hello")
```

priya: thanks laura — that snippet will be part of the PR. alex — good call on aliasing. i can add a single-sentence provenance line in the card that links back to the model source and license.

doc-bot: linkcheck: 3 broken links found (docs/model-sources.md#L42, /assets/bench/zephyrx/throughput.csv, https://old-bucket.redwood.ai/models/zephyrx-weights). CI recommends: replace absolute bucket paths and prefer /bench assets stored in docs repo.

samir: i'll take the bucket->repo asset migration. will copy throughput CSV into docs/assets/bench/zephyrx and update the PR.

mike: also, the benchmark numbers in the card are from a different batch window config. we should either re-run with the standard 200ms batch window or add a footnote stating the measurement config. small change but important for reproducibility.

alex: i'll add a short 'measurement methodology' subsection with the exact runner args + sequencelength used. that'll keep the bench numbers clear.

laura: quick ask — in the migration guide we tell customers to pin "variant: zephyrx-7b-int8" but the runtime mapping expects the variant label without the hyphen. can we add an explicit snippet showing how to pin both display name and runtime alias? example: ```yaml
routes:
  - model: zephyrx-7b
    variant_alias: zephyrx7b-int8
    pinned: true
```

priya: good catch. i'll add both examples (console pin + api snippet).

samir: patch plan: 1) move CSV assets into repo and update links (ETA today EOD), 2) update broken absolute URL to redirect or remove, 3) push updated SDK snippet per laura.

mike: after those, can someone volunteer to sanity-check the final card text for clarity? i can review bench/measurement wording.

alex: i'll do a pass on model naming + provenance wording and add a short blurb about license and model weights origin.

priya: perfect — once samir's asset fix + laura's SDK update + alex's naming pass are in, i'll merge. marking this high priority since a customer reported confusion. :thumbsup:

samir: pushing a small commit now to move the CSVs and flip the links. will ping when CI passes.

doc-bot: deploy-preview built. linkcheck now reports 1 broken link: https://old-bucket.redwood.ai/models/zephyrx-weights (still referenced from model-sources.md).

priya: i'll update model-sources.md to remove the old-bucket reference and point to the provenance block in the card instead.

laura: pushed SDK snippet update in the PR. left a note about adding an async example for streaming too (separate follow-up).

mike: LGTM on the methodology wording change. left one nit about clarifying 'tokens' vs 'tokens/sec' in the bench table.

alex: made a tiny commit to normalize 'ZephyrX-7B' casing across the card and add the provenance link.

priya: all set from my side. samir — any blockers on CI?

samir: CI flake earlier, re-run in progress. will confirm in ~10m.

doc-bot: CI passed. linkcheck clean. preview URL: https://deployments.preview.redwood.ai/docs/zephyrx-7b-card

priya: merging shortly. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :party_popper:

mike: thanks — will follow up with a short note to the internal model-onboarding channel about adding alias guidance to the template.

alex: added a tiny todo in the card: "re-run bench with quant flag once infra schedule allows" — low priority.

laura: thanks team. will open the streaming SDK snippet follow-up next week.

priya: closing thread after merge. :white_check_mark:
